services.name: Bike Sete Cidades Experience
services.desc: Explore the breathtaking Sete Cidades complex on two wheels with our captivating bike tour. Pedal through the heart of the volcanic caldera, where the terrain remains predominantly flat, offering an enjoyable ride for all. This circular route begins and concludes on the charming bridge that spans the tranquil lagoon. Our bike tour promises a perfect blend of fun and contemplation. It provides an intimate opportunity to immerse yourself in the beauty of the Sete Cidades valley, allowing you to intimately connect with the enchanting lagoons that grace this unique region on São Miguel Island. Get ready for an unforgettable adventure! São Miguel is the largest island of the Azores archipelago

services.name: Angra do Heroísmo Sunset Boat Tour
services.desc: Experience the unique charm of sailing with us on our boat “Navy Blue”, a classic Jeanneau Sun Liberty 34 with a maximum capacity of 6 passengers and 2 crew members. We strive to provide personalized attention to each guest, ensuring an unforgettable adventure along the stunning south coast of São Miguel. Our Half Day Cruise is 3-4 hours long and includes a stop for swimming (weather permitting), along with local snacks and drinks. The Full Day Cruise lasts 6-8 hours and includes a light meal with local products and drinks. During this cruise, we may even take you to Vila Franca do Campo to see its famous islet. São Miguel is the largest island of the Azores archipelago and a true paradise

explain.meaning: A guided horseback ride along trails, mostly at walking pace.

services.name: Whale Watching in São Miguel
services.desc: Embark on a 3-hour journey to meet the marine mammals of the Azores in their natural habitat. Our strategically-placed lookouts spot large cetaceans and cheerful dolphins, giving us the opportunity to admire them up close. Join us for a mix of fun, adventure, discovery, and scientific knowledge as you make memories to last a lifetime! São Miguel is the largest island of the Azores archipelago and a true paradise for nature lovers. With a magnificent landscape filled with crystal-clear lakes, green valleys, and volcanic craters, São Miguel is the perfect place for those who seek adventure and tranquility. The island is also famous for its tea plantations, hot springs, and stunning beaches.
